body: Owner report, 13 Nov 2026 (relayed from chat): some songs of an artist show under '[unknown album]' and are downloaded twice, once under the unknown album and once under the right one. Example: Landmvrks, 'Creature' and 'Requiem' belong to 'The Darkest Place I've Ever Lived' but also show under [unknown album]. Expected: one song, one entry, one download.
